# seerr_plex_devices (Data Source)

Get information about all available Plex server devices.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "seerr_plex_devices" "all" {}

output "plex_servers" {
  value = data.seerr_plex_devices.all.devices
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `devices` (Attributes List) List of Plex devices. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--devices))
- `id` (String) Placeholder ID for the data source.

<a id="nestedatt--devices"></a>
### Nested Schema for `devices`

Read-Only:

- `created_at` (String) Creation time.

- `dns_rebinding_protection` (Boolean) Whether DNS rebinding protection is enabled.
- `home` (Boolean) Whether the device is a home device.
- `https_required` (Boolean) Whether HTTPS is required.
- `last_seen_at` (String) Last seen time.
- `name` (String) Name of the Plex device.
- `nat_loopback_supported` (Boolean) Whether NAT loopback is supported.
- `owned` (Boolean) Whether the device is owned.
- `owner_id` (String) Owner ID.
- `platform` (String) Platform of the device.
- `platform_version` (String) Platform version.
- `presence` (Boolean) Presence status.
- `product` (String) Product name.

- `provides` (List of String) Services provided by the device.
- `public_address` (String) Public address.

- `relay` (Boolean) Whether the device uses a relay.

- `synced` (Boolean) Whether the device is synced.
